lockFileMaintenance.description: Re-resolve the lockfiles weekly so transitive deps stay current. The pep621 rule below only bumps packages declared in backend/pyproject.toml; lock-only deps pulled in through extras (requests via google-auth[requests], certifi, charset-normalizer) are invisible to that manager and otherwise sit at whatever version was resolved the last time something forced a full resolve.

packageRules.description: Bump the >= floors in backend/pyproject.toml, which also regenerates uv.lock. The default rangeStrategy only edits a manifest when the new version escapes the declared range, and an open-ended '>=x' is satisfied by every release — so without this the backend gets no update PRs at all.

Hold eslint at 9. The plugins eslint-config-next bundles (eslint-plugin-react, -jsx-a11y, -import) all cap their peer eslint at ^9, so eslint 10 installs only because npm downgrades the nested peer conflict to a warning. Drop this rule once those plugins declare eslint 10 support.
